title: cloud: measure whether the control plane reads manifest_json.devPlugins or judges a restriction profile server-side
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mw7HFYn9o4LEGMQdK

## What is unmeasured

#31264 and its two PRs (#31276, which merged, and #31277) settle the open-source side. `os build` now leaves `devPlugins` out of the artifact (`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`). The CLI restriction-profile reader no longer judges it as code (`NEVER_REACHES_TARGET` in `packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts`). The `RestrictionProfileSchema` `allowCode` docblock says so.

One reader is outside this repository. `os package publish` snapshots `dist/objectstack.json` into `sys_package_version.manifest_json`, and the cloud control plane may read that row. No seat on this side could reach `objectstack-ai/cloud`, so two questions are recorded as **not measured** (PR #31276 body and dev report 6713325766 on #31264):

1. Does any cloud code read `manifest_json.devPlugins`, for example to load, count or judge it?
2. Does cloud judge a restriction profile (`allowCode`, `allowedFlowNodeTypes`) server-side? If it does, does it read `devPlugins` as code? Does it accept the ADR-0031 containers `parallel` and `try_catch`, which the CLI reader now always allows (#31239, pending the maintainer's C/B pick)?

## Owed

- A grep of `objectstack-ai/cloud` for `devPlugins`, `manifest_json` readers and any restriction-profile judge. The answer goes on this card.
- If a reader exists, align it with the OSS rules above, or file the gap. An artifact built before `ea053b4a` still carries the key, so a reader that loads it would load dev-only plugins on a target.

## Where it came from

This is the residual from the contract review of PR #31277 (comment 6714938466 ③). It is filed so that the residual keeps a tracker once `Fixes #31264` closes that card.
